full_judgment: 36. In such suits, the issues raised are generally capable of being determined by documentary evidence. The Court can act on presumption that the transactions or dealings have taken place and accounts maintained by bank companies in conformity with the directives of the Bangladesh Bank. Cf Central Bank of India vs Ravindra, (2001) 1 SCC 367.
